The sandalwood and rosewood grown in abundance in Karnataka have led to a legacy of exquisite sandalwood carvings and intricate rosewood inlay work, kept alive by passing skills from generation to generation.","To preserve, develop and promote this craftsmanship, the Government of Karnataka established the Karnataka State Handicrafts Development Corporation Ltd (KSHDCL) in 1964.
